promptSet.title: Claude Code Project Rules Configuration (.clauderc)
promptSet.description: Generate a comprehensive .clauderc configuration file for a TypeScript full-stack project. Include guidelines on code formatting, preferred libraries, test runner commands, and strict security rules.
instructions: Install the Claude Code CLI using npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code.
Authenticate with your Anthropic account in your terminal.
Add custom project instructions in CLAUDE.md to keep your agent aligned.
promptSet.exampleOutput: A complete CLAUDE.md guidelines file tailored for modern React and Node.js codebases.
